_comment: Hand and review-pass corrections for tools/generate_deck_tr.py. _drop removes a word; other keys override gloss/gloss/pos/posName for that word.

_drop_reasons.in: analyser artefact: sentences are the verb inmek (to go down); not a core noun
_drop_reasons.dilmek: analyser artefact: sentences are dil (language) and dilemek (to wish/ask for); dilmek (to slice) is rare
_drop_reasons.se: analyser artefact: letter name 'se'; sentences are sence
_drop_reasons.gelen: participle (gelen) of gelmek, not an ordinary headword
_drop_reasons.al: analyser artefact: frequency comes from the imperative of almak; the colour word is rare
_drop_reasons.çıktı: finite past form of çıkmak; noun sense is niche
_drop_reasons.tabi: obscure sense; sentences use misspelled tabii ki
_drop_reasons.bulamak: analyser artefact; learner needs bulmak (sentences use bulmak)
_drop_reasons.karı: derogatory term; sentence 2 is a homograph (kar + accusative)
_drop_reasons.te: name of the letter T; sentences do not contain the word
_drop_reasons.üstüne: inflected form (possessive+dative) of üst; not a headword
_drop_reasons.döner: finite verb form of dönmek (analyser artefact)
_drop_reasons.tan: obscure/poetic word; sentences match other words (tanım, tanınmış)
_drop_reasons.verici: participle/suffix-like form (heyecan verici, utanç verici), not a real standalone headword
_drop_reasons.imek: analyser artefact (copula imek); learner needs the suffix/copula, not a headword
_drop_reasons.is: frequency artefact of English 'is'; 'is' (soot) is rare for a core list
_drop_reasons.has: frequency artefact of English 'has'; sentences use hasta; rare headword
_drop_reasons.koy: analyser artefact: sentences are imperative of koymak; koy (cove) is rare
_drop_reasons.ettirmek: rare causative of etmek, analyser artefact
_drop_reasons.it: derogatory/archaic word for dog (köpek is the normal word); confusable with English 'it'
_drop_reasons.sürümek: analyser artefact / rare variant of sürmek (to drive; to lead; to last)
_drop_reasons.hatun: slang/dated word for woman; sentences also contain a name
_drop_reasons.bası: wrong headword (analyser artefact for basın); bası is not the word taught
_drop_reasons.doğan: sentences use the participle doğan; the falcon sense is rare and mostly a name
_drop_reasons.testi: matches the loan 'test'; jug sense is rare and sentences use a different word
_drop_reasons.sav: obscure legal/math term; sentences use savcılık and savmak
_drop_reasons.çekecek: analyser artefact: çekecek (shoehorn) matched the future of çekmek
_drop_reasons.he: letter name / rare interjection; not a useful entry
_drop_reasons.keser: obscure tool term; sentences use verb kesmek
_drop_reasons.re: letter/musical note name; sentences are about 'ren' (reindeer)
_drop_reasons.zenci: dated and offensive term for Black people
_drop_reasons.tak: obscure noun (arch); sentences use imperative of takmak
_drop_reasons.halim: analyser artefact; sentences use hal + possessive (halim = my state)
_drop_reasons.sin: analyser artefact: sin (grave) is not what the sentences use (sinmek); rare
_drop_reasons.aleyh: bound form, occurs only as aleyhine/aleyhinde; not a standalone core headword
_drop_reasons.yâr: archaic/poetic word; attached sentence does not contain it
_drop_reasons.murat: archaic/literary word and common personal name
_drop_reasons.onlar: duplicate of the earlier core card onlar
_drop_reasons.sunu: obscure; learners need sunum; sentences use sunum
_drop_reasons.batman: proper noun (Batman / city); obscure Ottoman weight unit
_drop_reasons.harp: dated/Ottoman-origin word for war (savaş is standard)
_drop_reasons.gözlü: bound derived form (-li) only meaningful in compounds like aç gözlü
_drop_reasons.âmâ: archaic Ottoman word; sentences are homographs of ama/amaç
_drop_reasons.fatih: mainly a personal name; obscure as a common noun
_drop_reasons.yılmaz: surname/proper name (Yılmaz); negative aorist of yılmak
_drop_reasons.kut: archaic word (kut); sentences actually use kutu
_drop_reasons.aya: analyser artefact: sentences use dative of ay (moon)
_drop_reasons.ab: analyser artefact: sentences use the abbreviation AB (EU)
_drop_reasons.yağı: analyser artefact: sentences use yağ (oil, fat); yağı is archaic
_drop_reasons.akı: obscure physics term; sentences actually use akıcı
_drop_reasons.ağı: analyser artefact (ağ 'net' in possessive form; sentences use ağ)
_drop_reasons.yak: obscure animal; sentences use yakmak imperative
_drop_reasons.kadir: mainly a personal name; rare adjective (her şeye kadir) and obscure astronomy sense
_drop_reasons.hadis: religious technical term, obscure for a core list
_drop_reasons.azmak: rare verb; sentences use az (few), not azmak
_drop_reasons.ilmek: analyser artefact (ilmek); sentences are from ilerlemek
_drop_reasons.akar: analyser artefact: 'akar' is the aorist of akmak (to flow)
_drop_reasons.akis: analyser artefact: sentences and common word are aksi (opposite, contrary); akis is obscure
_drop_reasons.je: name of a letter; not a vocabulary word
_drop_reasons.amber: obscure (ambergris); sentences confuse it with kehribar
_drop_reasons.gayri: prefix-like element (gayri resmi is two words), not a standalone headword
_drop_reasons.ge: name of the letter G; sentences mismatched
_drop_reasons.seda: mostly a name; sentences use sedan
_drop_reasons.som: analyser artefact: som balığı is catfish (salmon is somon); sentences are about somun
_drop_reasons.zarfında: inflected (locative-possessive) form of zarf, not a headword
_drop_reasons.sör: foreign word (English 'sir') spelled in Turkish; colloquial
_drop_reasons.aş: archaic/obscure word; its sentences match aşı and aşmak
_drop_reasons.esen: participle of esmek (to blow); the 'healthy' sense is archaic
_drop_reasons.ışıl: bare stem that only occurs in the reduplication ışıl ışıl
_drop_reasons.cihan: literary/archaic; dünya is the everyday word
_drop_reasons.fe: name of the letter F; sentences use fen
_drop_reasons.karamak: analyser artefact; sentences use kararmak and kâr; karamak is rare
_drop_reasons.aza: archaic Ottoman word (üye is modern); sentences use az
_drop_reasons.tanış: rare noun; analyser artefact of tanışmak
_drop_reasons.yedi: duplicate of the earlier hand-written card for yedi (seven)
_drop_reasons.karlamak: analyser artefact; rare verb, sentences use kâr/kar nouns
_drop_reasons.sahra: proper noun (Sahara); çöl is the ordinary word
_drop_reasons.denet: analyser artefact; real headword is denetim
_drop_reasons.alp: obscure/archaic; mostly a given name; sentence uses Alp as the Alps
_drop_reasons.bayraktar: obscure/historical; also a brand and surname
_drop_reasons.basma: analyser artefact: negative imperative of basmak, not the noun
_drop_reasons.hazret: title of respect used with names; archaic/religious
_drop_reasons.travesti: offensive term; sentence shows a different word (travesty)
_drop_reasons.arya: technical music term, too obscure for core list
_drop_reasons.okey: foreign word 'OK' respelled; duplicate of loan interjection
_drop_reasons.yalçın: obscure poetic word, mostly a personal name
_drop_reasons.polat: archaic; mostly a personal name (modern word is çelik)
_drop_reasons.cihat: religious/historical term, politically loaded, also a personal name
_drop_reasons.elif: letter of the Arabic alphabet / personal name
_drop_reasons.saka: obscure bird species (goldfinch); sentence matches a different word
_drop_reasons.çat: obscure/analyser artefact; sentences use other words
_drop_reasons.fire: obscure technical term, looks like English word
_drop_reasons.çökermek: analyser artefact: sentence form is from çökmek; çökermek is not a real headword
_drop_reasons.ezel: archaic/religious-philosophical term, obscure for core list
_drop_reasons.bun: analyser artefact: bun is not a modern headword (sentences are bu + n)
_drop_reasons.ağızlı: derived suffix-form adjective used only in compounds (-mouthed)
_drop_reasons.necip: archaic/literary; now mainly a personal name
_drop_reasons.bacı: dialectal/regional; standard word is kız kardeş
_drop_reasons.server: English word spelled as in source language; gloss is wrong
_drop_reasons.pir: obscure religious term; sentences use other words (pirinç, pire)
_drop_reasons.tor: obscure; sentences use other words (Tor, torun)
_drop_reasons.duy: analyser artefact (imperative of duymak); obscure sense
_drop_reasons.beşer: literary/archaic; homograph with beşer 'five each'; sentences use beşeri
_drop_reasons.faik: archaic/literary and mostly a personal name
_drop_reasons.üzümlü: transparent derivative of üzüm; low value
_drop_reasons.programlanmak: passive form; real headword is programlamak
_drop_reasons.cumhur: archaic/Ottoman; occurs mainly in compounds (cumhuriyet, cumhurbaşkanı)
_drop_reasons.chat: English/French word spelled as in the source language
_drop_reasons.burunlu: rare derived -lı adjective; not needed in core list
_drop_reasons.frengi: sexually transmitted disease; obscure medical term
_drop_reasons.hidayet: religious term, rare in everyday use
_drop_reasons.müge: obscure flower; also a personal name
_drop_reasons.tulû: obscure Arabic-origin term; sentences actually use tulum
_drop_reasons.şaşılmak: impersonal passive of şaşmak, only used in fixed forms like şaşılacak
_drop_reasons.sikke: archaic/Ottoman word for coin (modern: madeni para, bozuk para)
_drop_reasons.kadı: qadi: historical/Islamic-law term, obscure for core list; sentences do not contain the word
_drop_reasons.piercing: English word spelled as in English
_drop_reasons.kıvanç: obscure, mostly known as a personal name
_drop_reasons.sağlıcakla: fixed farewell phrase element (sağlıcakla kalın), gloss wrong, not a core entry
_drop_reasons.attırmak: analyser artefact (causative of atmak); sentences use at 'horse'
_drop_reasons.maarif: archaic/official term; eğitim is the common word
_drop_reasons.şark: archaic variant of doğu; sentences use şarkı
_drop_reasons.biberli: derived adjective of low value; sentences are about pepperoni, not biber
_drop_reasons.jale: obscure literary word, also a personal name
_drop_reasons.utku: rare purist word, also a personal name
_drop_reasons.lanse: not a standalone word (lanse etmek, to launch)
_drop_reasons.ortaç: grammar term (participle), too technical for core list
_drop_reasons.mücahit: religious/political term, obscure for core list
_drop_reasons.torbalı: analyser artefact / mostly a place name; transparent derivative
_drop_reasons.talebe: archaic word for student (öğrenci); sentences are actually talep (demand)
_drop_reasons.kamer: archaic/poetic Arabic word (only in kameri ay)
_drop_reasons.alperen: obscure and mostly a personal name
_drop_reasons.buse: literary/poetic (öpücük is standard) and mostly a personal name
_drop_reasons.sevmemek: negated form of sevmek, not a separate headword
_drop_reasons.alacak: analyser artefact: sentences use the future form of almak (alacak); noun sense is niche
_drop_reasons.ala: analyser artefact; sentences are from almak (alalım); ala is an obscure adjective
_drop_reasons.sözleşmek: analyser artefact: sözleşmek is rare, sentences use the noun sözleşme (contract)
_drop_reasons.atışmak: analyser artefact: sentences are about atış (shot); atışmak rare
_drop_reasons.yazın: analyser artefact: yazın is mainly 'in summer' (yaz+ın) or imperative of yazmak; rare neologism sense
_drop_reasons.nam: archaic/obscure; only appears in compounds like namlı, nam salmak
_drop_reasons.katar: rare word; sentences come from hesaba katmak; also confusable with Qatar
_drop_reasons.holding: English word spelled as in the source language (holding)
_drop_reasons.oya: obscure craft term (also a personal name); sentences actually contain oyalanmak
_drop_reasons.iskender: specific dish name, also a personal name (İskender); too narrow for core list
_drop_reasons.bora: obscure literary word, mainly known as a personal name
_drop_reasons.bakir: ill-formed headword (noun is bakire); sexual sense, obscure adjective
_drop_reasons.start: English word spelled as in English
_drop_reasons.ekler: analyser artefact: sentences use verb ekler (adds); not a useful headword
_drop_reasons.dilli: not a standalone dictionary headword; suffixed form (-li) used in compounds like iki dilli
_drop_reasons.testis: anatomical genital term, low value for a core deck
_drop_reasons.ümmet: specialised religious term, too narrow for a core deck
_drop_reasons.çolak: rare term for a physical disability, potentially offensive
_drop_reasons.zikir: religious ritual term, too specialised for core list
_drop_reasons.vız: interjection-like fragment only used in the idiom 'vız gelmek'; not a standalone headword
